name: SaaSHub

sources.title: SaaSHub Submit a Product — guidelines and acceptance rules

requirements: Product must be released — unreleased products are rejected immediately
Must run on its own domain — free subdomains (e.g. my-cool-app.vercel.com, myproduct.saasify.com) are not accepted
Not accepted: software development agencies, waitlist/landing pages with just an email form
Accepted: SaaS/IaaS/PaaS, most software products and apps, mobile apps with decent websites, niche-leading sites
Submissions by email are not accepted — use the form only
All submissions go through an approval process; approved products can still be removed later
preparation: A few relevant categories — check competitors' category choices for inspiration
A competitor list — submissions without listed competitors are deprioritized to the bottom of the queue
An email address on the product's domain for optional verification (grants higher priority)
workflow: Submit the product URL and details via the form
Optionally verify the product with a domain email for higher queue priority
Wait for the approval process to complete
watchFor: Skipping the competitors field silently slows the submission to the bottom of the queue
Verification is optional but materially improves priority — needs a mailbox on the product domain
SaaSHub reserves the right to remove products even after approval
Separate 'Feature My Product' paid promotion exists but is not required to list
countsAsLive: A dedicated product page on saashub.com that also appears as an alternative on competitor product pages.
unknowns: Whether an account is required for submission or only for management
Which parts of the profile (logo, screenshots) are required vs optional in the form
